o2_voltage_capture.detail: Extended O2 voltage capture over 30 seconds at 2500 RPM steady-state. Voltage remains between 0.02-0.08V with no switching events. Normal O2 should switch between 0.1-0.9V at 1-3 Hz. Sensor is stuck railed lean.

o2_disconnect_trim_check.detail: With upstream O2 sensor disconnected (ECU enters open-loop/fixed fuel map), fuel trims reset to near zero within 5 seconds. ECU no longer chases the false lean signal. Engine runs correctly on base fuel map.

known_good_o2_swap.detail: With a known-good O2 sensor installed, voltage switches normally between 0.1-0.9V at ~2 Hz. Fuel trims begin learning down. Confirms the original sensor was the fault source.
